decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The concept doc still says public preview, on CLI and app for macOS and Windows. It is disabled by default and follows tool permission settings. No lifecycle change is shown. Tenant policy, data, audit, and network evidence is not in the fetch, so every gate stays unknown. Human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: Computer use is in public preview and subject to change.
Computer use is available in GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app on macOS and Windows.
Computer use is disabled by default. You must enable it before an agent can use its tools.
If you choose Always allow for a specific application, Copilot stores the decision locally.
